 Follow Taye Diggs Cast in The Chosen’s Christmas Spin-off, Release Date & First Look Revealed
 Surya Singh Tue, November 10, 2026 at 8:56 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Photo Credit: The CW Taye Diggs is joining The Chosen universe. The actor will play one of the three kings in the upcoming Christmas special, The Chosen: The Three Kings . The first look video also gives fans a glimpse of his new role.
 Diggs will portray Balthasar, one of the Magi who travel to Bethlehem after witnessing an extraordinary celestial event. Piter Marek joins him as Melchior, while Rahul Rai plays Gaspar. The special marks the third and final installment in The Chosen Christmas trilogy.
 The story follows the Magi as they recognize a bright light above Bethlehem as the fulfillment of an ancient prophecy. Fearing political changes under their rulers, the three men begin a dangerous journey to honor the newborn king. However, their arrival brings an unexpected discovery that changes their understanding of the mission.
 What to expect from Taye Diggs in The Chosen: The Three Kings?
 Diggs' Balthasar will be a central figure in this retelling of Jesus' birth. Unlike stories focused mainly on Mary and Joseph, this special follows the travelers who journeyed from distant lands. Their political fears and personal decisions give another perspective on the familiar Nativity story.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The first-look video introduces the kings and shows what drives them to Bethlehem. It also builds anticipation around their meeting with the newborn Jesus. Sara Anne and Raj Bond appear as Young Mary and Joseph, connecting the travelers' journey to the events surrounding Jesus' arrival.
 This installment continues a holiday tradition that began with The Shepherd in 2017. The second special, Christmas with The Chosen: The Messengers, followed in 2021. However, The Three Kings marks the franchise's first Christmas special to premiere on a major broadcast network.
 Diggs has worked across film, television, and Broadway. His screen credits include The Best Man, How Stella Got Her Groove Back , and Private Practice. He also originated Benjamin Coffin III in the Broadway musical Rent. His other stage credits include Chicago, Wicked, and Moulin Rouge!.
 The Chosen: The Three Kings premieres Monday, December 14, 2026, on FOX. The 90-minute special airs from 8 to 9:30 p.m. ET/PT. Viewers can also stream it on Hulu the following day.
